name: Belshazzar
bio: Belshazzar, king of Babylon, threw a great feast for a thousand of his nobles, during which he drunkenly ordered the gold and silver vessels looted from Jerusalem's temple brought out so his guests could drink from them while praising pagan gods. A disembodied hand then wrote mysterious words on the palace wall; terrified, Belshazzar summoned Daniel, who interpreted it as God's verdict that Belshazzar's kingdom had been weighed and found wanting, and would be given to the Medes and Persians. That very night, Belshazzar was killed and his kingdom fell (Daniel 5:1-31).
